svg.title: Network checks: name, connection and HTTP.
svg.desc: An illustrative name lookup maps example.com to a documentation IP address, then a client tries the HTTPS TCP port and reads an HTTP response. The IP is illustrative, not an asserted current address. Names, IP addresses, connections and HTTP responses are defined separately; success at one step does not guarantee the next.
svg.text: An IP address identifies a network destination; a name is a readable label.
DNS looks up name records, including addresses. Connecting is a separate step.
Illustrative HTTPS check; this IP is an example, not the site's current address:
TCP carries data between connected programs. One successful check isn't all three.
HTTP exchanges requests and responses; a response can report an error.
HTTPS encrypts the exchange and checks the server's identity.
